'''Jean Paul Nightfall''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Jean Paul]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls87.htm Nightfall], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319193747/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls87.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
